name: Technical Project Scoping Agent
description: Conversational AI agent that guides technical project scoping calls in Google Meet

steps.text: Hi there! I'm your technical scoping assistant. Today we're going to work together to define the scope and requirements for your project. This should take about 20-30 minutes.

I'll be asking you questions in several areas: project basics, technical requirements, scope and deliverables, resources and constraints, and success criteria. After we collect all the information, I'll summarize everything for your records.
Ready to get started? Just let me know when you're ready to begin.
Let's start with the basics. What's the name of your project?
Great! And who's the main client or stakeholder for this project?
When do you need this project to be completed? Please give me a timeline or target date.
Do you have a budget allocated for this project?
Perfect! I've noted that {project_name} is for {client_name}, due by {timeline}, with a budget of {budget}. Does that sound right?
Now let's dive into the technical side. What technology stack are you envisioning for this project? For example, frontend frameworks, backend languages, databases, etc.
Are there any systems or services you need to integrate with?
What are the performance or scale requirements? For example, expected number of users, data volume, response time requirements?
Do you have any security or data privacy requirements we should be aware of?

sections.name: Scope & Deliverables
sections.description: Define what's in and out of scope

steps.text: Let's clearly define what we're building. First, what would be your Minimum Viable Product? In other words, what's the absolute minimum set of features needed to launch?
Great! And what are some nice-to-have features that we could consider adding if we have time and budget?
Are there any features or requirements that are explicitly OUT of scope for this project?
How many people will be available on your team to work on this project?
Are there any existing systems, infrastructure, or code we need to work with or build on?
Are you aware of any technical debt or existing issues that might affect this project?
Are there any third-party tools, services, or dependencies we should know about?

sections.name: Success Criteria
sections.description: Define how success will be measured

steps.text: How will we measure success for this project? What are the key metrics or outcomes?
When should the project launch?
Will there be ongoing support or maintenance required after launch?
Who needs to sign off or approve the final scope?

sections.name: Summary & Confirmation
sections.description: Review and confirm all collected information

steps.text: Perfect! Let me summarize what we've discussed for {project_name}:
Does everything look correct? Are you ready to move forward with this scope?

options: No, I need to revise something
I need to discuss with my team first

steps.condition: No, I need to revise something
steps.action: ask: Which section would you like to revisit?

steps.text: Excellent! I've recorded all the details from our scoping call. A complete scoping document will be generated and sent to you shortly.

The next steps are:
1. You'll receive a scoping document for review
2. Share it with your stakeholders ({stakeholder_signoff})
3. Schedule a follow-up call to finalize any details
4. Begin technical planning and architecture design
Is there anything else you'd like to add or clarify before we wrap up?
Thanks for spending time on this scoping call! I'll send over the complete documentation to {client_name}. Have a great day!
